subject: REDEFINES clause

LANDED 2026-10-07 (PB2518): the 'without intervening entries that define new storage areas' half is asked by ScreenRedefinesEntry/FirstInterveningStorage over the scope the pair was resolved in (the subject's siblings, or the roots of its own section): every entry between data-name-2 and the subject must itself be a redefinition, else COBOL2739. The overlay layout (ClassifyRedefinesClasses) tolerates a gap and never diagnosed one; the earlier note naming it the witness was wrong (a layout that tolerates the violation is not a diagnosis). A CONSTANT entry and a TYPEDEF template are off the scope and define no storage.
